mission: Use paid, proprietary, hosted and premium ecosystems as research inputs while keeping project runtime spend at $0.
definition_of_zero_cost: No additional paid subscription, paid trial, payment-method-dependent feature, metered external service, paid runner, or paid hosted dependency is required for canonical project execution.

economic_disposition.meaning: Existing GitHub/Cloudflare/project capability already covers the feature.
Combine existing free capabilities to reproduce the user-visible function.
Use an open-source implementation on existing permitted compute/storage.
A documented free allowance exists and is enforced by a hard resource gate.
Direct use would create paid/billing dependency.
Paid feature is analyzed and its safe public behavior is rebuilt with free/native components.
No safe $0 equivalent has yet been proven.

promotion_gate: differential or parity tests where applicable

mcp.scope_note: Supplied MCP workbook page, not the entire global Registry.

prohibited_shortcuts: install a paid Marketplace App just to obtain its feature
start a paid-plan free trial as a substitute for implementation
add an external SaaS dependency without an evidenced $0 operating path
use larger or paid GitHub Actions runners
make an external service the acceptance authority
copy proprietary code or copyrighted assets without permission
